subject.title: fix(cli): setup rejects invalid gateway ports

question: Should `onboard` and `setup` intentionally change malformed explicit `--gateway-port` values from silently ignored inputs into immediate nonzero failures?
rationale: These setup commands are public CLI surfaces, and the correct bug fix deliberately breaks automation that currently relies—intentionally or accidentally—on malformed values being ignored.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
options.body: Land the patch and treat every explicitly malformed gateway port as an operator error before setup or config access.

options.title: Add a transition window
options.body: Preserve the current fallback temporarily with a warning and announce a later hard-error release, accepting continued ambiguous automation meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Land the patch and treat every explicitly malformed gateway port as an operator error before setup or config access.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged gateway-port validation work makes this person the strongest feature-history routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
